## Purpose and resulting behavior

Describe the problem and what this change does. Link related issues if any.

## Validation

List the checks performed and their results. Note anything not verified.
For documentation changes, include link and consistency checks as appropriate.

## Review checklist

- [ ] This pull request targets `develop` and stays focused on one change.
- [ ] Relevant behavior is covered by tests, or this change does not need tests.
- [ ] GUI text changes include all three maintained TS catalogs and verified
      regenerated QM files, or no GUI text was changed.
- [ ] Generated artifacts have not been force-added against the ignore rules.
